'''Dominaire''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. He managed the gladiatorial [[Arena Grand]], which he claimed was the greatest source of entertainment in all of the Eternal Empire. In [[3630 BBY]] he booked a fight for [[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]], who would go on to become the Eternal Champion of the Arena.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dominaire appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the NPC on Zakuul who starts the "Eternal Championship". He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
